python3 /home/ankit114/repos/paid_ads_mybcat/scripts/secret_exec.py --secret-env BLAND_API_KEY=mybcat/ai/api-keys/bland -- python3 -u - <<'PY' > sms-config.txt 2>&1
import json, os, re, urllib.request, urllib.error
raw = os.environ['BLAND_API_KEY'].strip()
if raw.startswith('{'):
    try:
        p = json.loads(raw)
        raw = next((p[k] for k in ('api_key','key','value') if p.get(k)), raw)
    except Exception:
        pass
NUM = '+15095611012'
for path in (f'/v1/inbound/{NUM}', f'/v1/sms/number/{NUM}', '/v1/sms/numbers', f'/v1/sms/config?phone_number={NUM}', '/v1/sms/conversations?limit=1'):
    req = urllib.request.Request('https://api.bland.ai' + path, headers={'Authorization': raw, 'User-Agent': 'mybcat-sms-config-probe'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
            body = r.read().decode()[:1200]
            status = r.status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        status, body = e.code, e.read().decode(errors='replace')[:300]
    except Exception as e:
        status, body = 0, f'{type(e).__name__}: {e}'
    body = re.sub(r'\d{7,}', lambda m: '***' + m.group(0)[-4:], ' '.join(str(body).split()))
    print(f'ENDPOINT={path} STATUS={status} BODY={body}')
PY
rc=$?; cat sms-config.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check: grep -q 'STATUS=200' sms-config.txt || { echo 'FAIL: no endpoint answered 200:'; cat sms-config.txt; exit 1; }; echo 'PASS: config read recorded'; grep -oE 'ENDPOINT=[^ ]+ STATUS=[0-9]+' sms-config.txt
